f.title: Establish PV SOPs and a safety information management system
f.statement: Manufacturers, importers and product licence holders shall establish standard operating procedures and a safety information management system to perform pharmacovigilance properly.

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.quote: ① 의약품 제조업자등은 약물감시를 적절히 수행하기 위한 업무기준서 및 안전성 정보관리 체계를 갖추어야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (1) Manufacturers, etc. of medicinal products shall establish standard operating procedures and a safety information management system to perform pharmacovigilance properly.

f.title: Pass all safety information to the safety management officer and support the role
f.statement: Manufacturers, etc. shall pass all collected safety information to the safety management officer and actively support the officer in performing pharmacovigilance.

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.quote: ② 의약품 제조업자등은 수집된 의약품의 모든 안전성 정보를 안전관리책임자에게 전달하고 약물감시 업무를 충실히 수행할 수 있도록 적극 지원하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (2) Manufacturers, etc. shall pass all collected safety information on medicinal products to the safety management officer and actively support the officer so that pharmacovigilance can be performed faithfully.

f.title: Safety management officer collects, evaluates and reports AEs, disseminates information and trains staff
f.statement: The safety management officer shall carry out the collection, analysis, evaluation and reporting of adverse events, the dissemination of new safety information, and internal staff training on pharmacovigilance.
f.processes: Safety governance; Training & competency; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: ③ 안전관리책임자는 의약품의 유해사례 수집·분석·평가·보고, 새로운 안전성 정보 전파 및 약물감시에 대한 내부직원 교육을 실시하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (3) The safety management officer shall carry out the collection, analysis, evaluation and reporting of adverse events of medicinal products, the dissemination of new safety information, and internal staff training on pharmacovigilance.

f.title: Perform PV for all approved products from the approval date
f.statement: Manufacturers, etc. shall perform pharmacovigilance under this Notice for all products approved by the MFDS from the date of product approval, except matters governed by the Standards for Re-examination of New Drugs.
f.exceptions: Matters set in the Standards for Re-examination of New Drugs, etc.

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.deadline: From the date of product approval
rows.quote: ④ 의약품등의 제조업자등은 식약처장의 품목허가를 받은 모든 의약품등에 대해 품목허가일로부터 이 고시를 적용하여 약물감시를 수행하여야 한다. 단, 「신약 등의 재심사 기준」에서 정한 사항은 제외한다.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (4) Manufacturers, etc. shall perform pharmacovigilance applying this Notice to all medicinal products approved by the MFDS from the date of product approval; however, matters set in the "Standards for Re-examination of New Drugs, etc." are excluded.

f.title: Report new safety findings needing additional measures with background, foreign status and action plan
f.statement: Where, in the course of pharmacovigilance, manufacturers find new safety-related information or judge additional safety measures necessary, they may report it to the MFDS attaching the background, analysis/evaluation results and supporting data; foreign approval particulars and measures; and an action plan (including a comparison table and draft changes where label changes are needed).

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.quote: ③ 의약품등의 제조업자등은 약물감시 수행 과정에서 안전성과 관련된 새로운 정보를 발견하거나 추가적인 안전대책이 필요하다고 판단되는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 자료를 첨부하여 식약처장에게 보고할 수 있다.
data_elements: label change comparison table and draft
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (3) Where, in the course of pharmacovigilance, manufacturers, etc. discover new safety-related information or judge that additional safety measures are necessary, they may report to the MFDS attaching the following documents.

f.title: Report foreign sale-suspension/recall measures and MFDS-instructed information within 15 days
f.statement: Manufacturers, etc. shall promptly report to the MFDS within 15 days from the day they became aware of a foreign government measure equivalent to suspension of sale or recall, or other serious information the MFDS has instructed to be reported.
f.clause: Article 9(1) Expedited reporting of safety information
f.legal_basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Arts 37-3, 38, 42; Rules Arts 47, 48, 60
f.applicability: Foreign sale suspension or recall-equivalent measures; other serious information the MFDS instructs to be reported

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.deadline: Within 15 days from the day of awareness
rows.quote: ① 법 제37조의3, 제38조, 제42조 및 규칙 제47조, 제48조, 제60조에 따라 의약품등의 제조업자 등은 다음 각 호의 사항을 알게 된 날부터 15일 이내에 식약처장에게 신속히 보고하여야 한다.
rows.location: Article 9(1) Expedited reporting of safety information
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (1) Under Articles 37-3, 38 and 42 of the Act and Articles 47, 48 and 60 of the Rules, manufacturers, etc. shall promptly report the following to the MFDS within 15 days from the day they became aware of them.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Foreign government measures equivalent to sale suspension or recall; MFDS-instructed serious information

f.title: Report serious ADRs (domestic and foreign) to KIDS within 15 days
f.statement: Manufacturers, etc., drug wholesalers, pharmacy founders and medical institution founders shall promptly report a serious ADR to the President of KIDS within 15 days from the day they became aware of it; the same applies to serious ADRs occurring abroad.

rows.actor: Manufacturers, etc.; drug wholesalers; pharmacy and medical institution founders
rows.deadline: Within 15 days from the day of awareness
rows.quote: ② 법 제68조의8에 따라 의약품등의 제조업자등, 의약품도매상, 약국개설자 및 의료기관개설자는 중대한 약물유해반응을 알게 된 날부터 15일 이내에 의약품안전원장에게 신속히 보고하여야 한다. 외국에서 발생한 중대한 약물유해반응을 알게 된 경우에도 이와 같다.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (2) Under Article 68-8 of the Act, manufacturers, etc., drug wholesalers, pharmacy founders and medical institution founders shall promptly report a serious adverse drug reaction to the President of KIDS within 15 days from the day they became aware of it. The same applies when they become aware of a serious adverse drug reaction that occurred abroad.

f.title: Submit expedited reports via the KIDS website or Form 1 with electronic file
f.statement: Expedited serious ADR reports shall be made through the KIDS website, or prepared on Form 1 and sent with an electronic file by post, fax, etc.

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.quote: ③ 제2항에 따른 안전성 정보의 신속보고는 의약품안전원 홈페이지를 통해 보고하거나 별지 제1호 서식에 따라 작성한 후 전자파일과 함께 우편·팩스 등을 통하여 보고하도록 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: "하도록 한다" read as a directive (Mandatory). Double-check: agreed; confidence 85 for modal nuance.
rows.quote_en: (3) Expedited reporting of safety information under paragraph (2) shall be made through the KIDS website, or prepared according to Form 1 and reported by post, fax, etc. together with an electronic file.

f.title: Report non-expedited safety information quarterly within one month of quarter end
f.statement: Manufacturers, etc. and drug wholesalers shall report to KIDS, within one month after the end of each quarter, collected information (Article 5(1) items 1-5) not reported as expedited; where impossible for unavoidable reasons, they may submit the reason for delay and planned reporting date.
f.clause: Article 10(1) Periodic reporting of safety information
f.exceptions: Delay permitted for unavoidable reasons with reason and planned date submitted.

rows.deadline: Within 1 month after the end of each quarter
rows.quote: ① 의약품등의 제조업자등 및 의약품 도매상은 제5조제1항제1호부터 제5호의 수집대상 정보 중 제9조에 따라 신속보고 되지 아니한 정보는 매 분기 종료 후 1개월 이내에 의약품안전원장에게 보고하여야 한다. 다만, 부득이한 사유로 해당 기간 내에 보고할 수 없는 경우에는 지연사유와 보고예정일을 명시하여 의약품안전원장에게 제출할 수 있다.
rows.location: Article 10(1) Periodic reporting of safety information
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (1) Manufacturers, etc. and drug wholesalers shall report to the President of KIDS, within one month after the end of each quarter, information among the items in Article 5(1) items 1 to 5 that was not reported as expedited under Article 9. However, where they cannot report within that period for unavoidable reasons, they may submit to the President of KIDS a statement specifying the reason for delay and the planned reporting date.

f.title: Include post-marketing trial result reports in the periodic report when completed
f.statement: Where a separate result report is prepared (e.g. a post-marketing clinical trial), it shall be included in the periodic report for the period in which the report is completed.
f.applicability: Post-marketing clinical trials and other studies with a separate result report

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.quote: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 시판 후 임상시험과 같이 별도의 결과보고서가 작성되는 경우에는 보고서가 완료된 시점을 기준으로 해당 기간 정기보고에 이를 포함하도록 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: "하도록 한다" read as directive. Double-check: agreed.
rows.quote_en: (2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), where a separate result report is prepared, such as for a post-marketing clinical trial, it shall be included in the periodic report for the relevant period based on the time the report is completed.

f.title: Submit periodic reports via KIDS website or Form 1 with electronic file
f.statement: Periodic reports shall be made through the KIDS website, or prepared on Form 1 and sent with an electronic file by post, fax, etc.

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.quote: ③ 제1항에 따라 안전성 정보의 정기보고는 의약품안전원 홈페이지를 통해 보고하거나 별지 제1호 서식에 따라 작성한 후 전자파일과 함께 우편·팩스 등을 통하여 보고하도록 한다.
rows.quote_en: (3) Periodic reporting of safety information under paragraph (1) shall be made through the KIDS website, or prepared according to Form 1 and reported by post, fax, etc. together with an electronic file.

f.title: Report foreign safety measures not reported as expedited within the quarter
f.statement: Manufacturers, etc. shall promptly report to the MFDS within the relevant quarter data on foreign safety-related measures (Article 5(1) item 7) not reported under Article 9; where impossible for unavoidable reasons, they may submit the reason for delay and planned date.
f.exceptions: Delay permitted for unavoidable reasons with reason and planned date submitted.

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.quote: ⑤ 의약품등의 제조업자등은 제5조제1항제7호의 수집 대상 정보 중 제9조에 따라 보고되지 아니한 정보는 당해 분기 내에 신속하게 식약처장에게 보고하여야 한다. 다만, 부득이한 사유로 해당 기한 내에 보고할 수 없는 경우에는 지연사유와 보고예정일을 명시하여 식약처장에게 제출할 수 있다.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (5) Manufacturers, etc. shall promptly report to the MFDS within the relevant quarter information under Article 5(1) item 7 that was not reported under Article 9. However, where they cannot report within that deadline for unavoidable reasons, they may submit to the MFDS a statement specifying the reason for delay and the planned reporting date.

f.title: Cooperate with MFDS pharmacovigilance inspections (7 days notice)
f.statement: The MFDS may inspect manufacturers' pharmacovigilance systems and operations; it gives at least 7 days' advance notice and the manufacturer shall cooperate.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.quote: ② 제1항의 실태조사를 실시하는 경우 적어도 7일 전까지는 해당 의약품등의 제조업자등 및 관련 기관에 이를 통지하여야 하고 해당 의약품등의 제조업자등 및 관련기관의 장은 이에 협조하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: (2) When an inspection under paragraph (1) is conducted, the manufacturer, etc. and relevant institution shall be notified at least 7 days in advance, and the manufacturer, etc. and the head of the relevant institution shall cooperate.

f.title: Implement MFDS-ordered product information changes by the deadline
f.statement: When the MFDS orders a change of product particulars by a deadline based on safety evaluation, the manufacturer shall by the deadline record the change date and content on the back of the approval/notification certificate and keep it; ship all products after the change date with the changed content attached; notify suppliers (wholesalers, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies) of products already in distribution; and post the change on its website.
f.clause: Article 15 Management of product approval certificates
f.legal_basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Art 76(1); Rules Art 8(3)

rows.actor: Manufacturer, importer or product licence holder (제조업자등)
rows.deadline: By the deadline set by the MFDS
rows.quote: 제15조(품목허가증의 관리 등) 의약품등의 안전성 정보 평가결과에 따라 법 제76조제1항 및 규칙 제8조제3항에 의해 식약처장이 정해진 기한까지 품목의 변경을 지시한 경우에는 당해 의약품등의 제조업자등은 다음 각 호의 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다.
rows.location: Article 15 Management of product approval certificates
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 15 (Management of product approval certificates, etc.) Where, according to the results of safety information evaluation, the MFDS has instructed a change of product particulars by a set deadline under Article 76(1) of the Act and Article 8(3) of the Rules, the manufacturer, etc. of the product shall take the following necessary actions.

f.title: Keep personal data from safety information confidential
f.statement: Persons collecting, analysing and evaluating safety information who learn personal information shall keep it confidential and shall not disclose it without the data subject's consent.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Persons engaged in safety information work (including company PV staff)
rows.quote: 제18조(개인정보의 보호 등) 의약품등 안전성 정보의 수집·분석 및 평가 등의 업무에 종사하는 자가 개인정보를 알게 된 경우에는 비밀보장이 유지되도록 취급하여야 하며, 이를 당해 정보주체의 동의없이 공개하여서는 안된다.
rows.review_note: Review: re-translated the quote independently; meaning, modal force and numbers agree with quote_en. Double-check: level follows the Korean modal; statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 18 (Protection of personal information, etc.) Persons engaged in collecting, analysing and evaluating safety information on medicinal products, etc. who learn personal information shall handle it so that confidentiality is maintained, and shall not disclose it without the consent of the data subject.
